how: We read the website of every Seattle wedding DJ listed on Lazo (31 listings, 23 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: a photo booth company that also DJs, a national chain's Seattle landing page, a party rental and planning outfit, and a DJ whose site had no readable content. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Who exactly will be at my wedding, and can I talk to that DJ before I sign?
For a farm or island venue: do you bring your own power backup and a separate ceremony sound system, and have you worked that venue's noise cutoff?
What is in the base price, and what are ceremony audio, uplighting, photo booth and extra hours on top?

picks.name: SG Mobile DJ Service, LLC
picks.blurb: Jeff Onorato founded SG Mobile DJ Service in 2010 but has played weddings and events since 1998, starting with his father's company in Flagstaff. The site explains the two systems used at a wedding: a full PA for the reception and a separate setup for the ceremony.

picks.name: Music Masters DJ's
picks.blurb: Music Masters started behind the decks at a Florida nightclub in the late 90s and has run DJ and MC services for weddings, schools and companies across Kitsap County since 2005. Bainbridge Island is home, which matters if your wedding is on the ferry side.

picks.name: Limitless Event DJs
picks.blurb: Started by Billy Heany in 2014 with a background in live music, Limitless Event DJs fields DJs and MCs for weddings across Washington and describes them as entertainers rather than playlist operators. Coverage runs from ceremony through the last dance.

picks.name: Sounds Unlimited
picks.blurb: Sounds Unlimited in Lynnwood matches you with a DJ by your music and personality preferences and gives you online tools to build a playlist and plan the reception. Wedding packages are tiered Classic, Elite, Ultimate and Premier, with school dances and mitzvahs as the other lines.

picks.name: Torchlight Entertainment
picks.blurb: Leah Evans founded Torchlight Entertainment in Federal Way in April 2012 after working as an in-house karaoke host and emcee since 2009. It now calls itself an all-inclusive wedding and event entertainment company, locally owned and licensed by the state.

picks.name: Groove on Hyde Street DJs
picks.blurb: Groove on Hyde Street in Shoreline runs a team of DJs and entertainers and prices a la carte, with packages that include tokens to redeem against add-ons. Every package is six hours covering ceremony, cocktail hour and reception, with prelude music built in.

picks.name: Headsmile Productions DJ
picks.blurb: Headsmile Productions pitches itself as a fun, professional and affordable Seattle DJ and MC service with more than 15 years in the business. The site details the gear, digital turntables, lighting and wireless microphones, and lists what each package includes.

picks.name: Heart and Soul Audio
picks.blurb: Heart and Soul Audio is DJ Nick in Tacoma, who tailors song lists for anything from an intimate gathering to a 600-person event and uses a broadcast journalism background to emcee. Customized receptions from a large music library.

picks.name: Sweet Sounds DJ
picks.blurb: Sweet Sounds is a Kirkland MC and DJ service for weddings and corporate events whose owner makes a point of not working like the larger DJ companies that hire from Craigslist. The promise is superior service at a fair price, personally delivered.

picks.name: Donhau Entertainment
picks.blurb: DonHau Entertainment in Lynnwood counts 12-plus years and 360 or more celebrations with, in its words, zero missed cues. One team covers MC hosting, music from the processional to the final song, uplighting designed around the venue and an open-air photo booth with instant prints.

picks.name: Love, Vows and Music
picks.blurb: Love, Vows and Music is one Seattle operator who can be your officiant, DJ, master of ceremonies and coordinator in a single booking, with lighting as well. The site links real ceremony footage so you can watch a wedding being run at venues like the Club at Newcastle.

picks.name: Direct Entertainment and Video
picks.blurb: Direct Entertainment bundles DJ, photography, video and photo booths under one Bellevue company founded over 15 years ago by Jim Firth, who has almost 25 years in the industry. The DJ package is printed at $995 when bundled with another service, four hours of music with a wireless mic for toasts.
